items.title: North Korean Hackers Evade UN Sanctions Leveraging Cyber Capabilities, IT Workers and Crypto Activities
items.description: The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) has intensified its global cyber operations, systematically violating United Nations Security Council resolutions through large-scale cyberattacks, cryptocurrency theft, and cross-border money laundering schemes. According to the Multilateral Sanctions Monitoring Team (MSMT) report, North Korean hackers stole at least USD 1.19 billion in…
